---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement to the journal, harness, CLI, or replay UI
title: "[feat]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What pain are you solving? Who is affected (library users, operators, contributors)?

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior you want. API sketches or CLI examples welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you evaluated and why you prefer this one.

## Milestone / gates

Which gates should cover this change (if any)?

- [ ] `npm test` / `gate` (M1)
- [ ] `gate:m2` (fork)
- [ ] `gate:m3` (replay / export)
- [ ] `gate:m4` (neutrality)
- [ ] `gate:m5` (HITL)
- [ ] `gate:all` (full serial suite)
- [ ] Not applicable (docs-only / tooling)

## Additional context

Links, prior art, or constraints (substrate neutrality, idempotency, security).
